group.label: Private Content Invalidation
group.comment: Customer data — the mini cart, the greeting, the message banner — is fetched over customer/section/load, which no cache can hold. Some actions tell the browser that every section is stale, so one login refetches all of them, including sections that are the same for every visitor on earth. Run bin/magento kingletas:section-policy:report --measure before changing anything here: it prints which actions are that wide and what each section costs.

field.label: Apply The Policy
field.comment: Off out of the box, because narrowing an invalidation decides what a signed-in shopper is shown. Nothing changes until a section is named below, whichever way this is set. Sections that say who the shopper is — customer, cart and messages — are refused even when they are named, and the report says so.

field.label: Sections An Account Action Never Needs To Refetch
field.comment:
Comma-separated section names, taken out of the four customer/account/* actions that currently invalidate everything. The usual first entry is directory-data — the country and region list, which is store configuration rather than anything about the shopper and is routinely the great majority of the response.
Leave a section off this list and it keeps being invalidated, so a section you have not thought about is never quietly dropped. A name that is not a registered section fails the report rather than being ignored.
